Description: Generates ReID embeddings for tracked objects via Triton Inference Server or a local TensorRT engine
Attaches generated embeddings directly to DeepStream tracked-object metadata using native C pointers
Skips embedding generation for objects smaller than min-crop-size
Caches per-object embeddings (smart-infer) and periodically re-infers them (cache-refresh-interval), avoiding redundant inference for already-embedded tracked objects
Uses hardware optical flow motion vectors (ofa-predict) to transform cached embeddings instead of re-inferring when object motion is below a configurable threshold
Gates full vision-encoder inference behind a lightweight DLA (or GPU fallback) appearance-change detector
